title: Thank You for Arguing
author: Jay Heinrichs
summary: An accessible introduction to persuasion in everyday situations, connecting classical rhetorical ideas with modern examples. Use it to notice audience, timing, and how an argument is presented.

title: The Art of Being Right
author: Arthur Schopenhauer
summary: A catalog of tactics people use to prevail in disputes. Study the tactics as patterns to recognize and counter; rhetorical victory and a sound conclusion are different goals.

title: How to Win Every Argument
author: Madsen Pirie
summary: A guide to common errors of reasoning and how they appear in arguments. Use its fallacy discussions to diagnose an inference precisely and repair it with better support.
